blocks.text: Any person that demolishes any structure within the City limits shall plug or cap the sewer line thereof in accordance with City Engineering Division specifications. (Code 1981 § 10-458. Code 1995 § 26-522.)

text:
Any person that demolishes any structure within the City limits shall plug or cap the sewer line thereof in accordance with City Engineering Division specifications. (Code 1981 § 10-458. Code 1995 § 26-522.)
Cross References: City Engineer, TMC 2.20.100 .
title: Sewer line to be capped.
